verdict.rationale: ADK ships a first-party evaluation framework with groundtruth and rubric-based metrics, expected tool-use trajectories, evalset.json test files, and a documented CLI command (`adk eval <agent> <evalset>`) that can be scripted/invoked headlessly, which is exactly the shape needed for CI integration. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation (e.g., a GitHub Actions example) and independent/third-party corroboration of running adk eval in CI.
